written: 2026-10-03, after the BTC FAIL (12befe9) and Chief Advisor ruling B; BEFORE any classifier run on this instrument. Thresholds 260beabd (unrevised).
tests: TRANSFER of the frozen CRISIS/HIGH_VOL thresholds through this instrument's own returns and 365d vol percentile. NOT independence: alt crashes co-move with BTC's.

criteria.crisis_event: CRISIS fires on a day in [event, event + 2 days]; events before the instrument's first bar + 5 days are N/A, not counted; PASS if hits >= 80% of available events; every miss is listed
criteria.crisis_rate: CRISIS on <= 3% of the instrument's days in 2020-01-01 .. 2025-09-30
criteria.high_vol_window: HIGH_VOL on >= 50% of the window's non-CRISIS days

crisis_events_rule: every BTC-USDT-SWAP 1d close-to-close return <= -10% in 2020-01-01 .. 2025-09-30, days within 3 of the previous event merged into it (generated mechanically from BTC bars; the rule is applied to BTC, not to this instrument, which would be tautological with the CRISIS rule)
